name: Peony Gardisto Idocrase
original_name: ピオニィ・ガルディスト＝アイドクレイス
source: Cactus's adoptive younger sister.  She is an apothecary/doctor sent to the village.  She is a good person at heart.  [spoiler] On the orders of the Prime Minister she was sent to find and investigate Cactus.  She is a member of the new King's Ear and does have a certain potential for ruthlessness. [/spoiler]
